{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Apply constraints: completed and revenue != 999999.99
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding revenue = 999999.99): {total_revenue}')

# Confirm the number of rows excluded
total_rows = len(df)
excluded_rows = total_rows - len(df_filtered)
print(f'Rows excluded: {excluded_rows}')"}
